claims.text: Supportive: prophylactic SC LMWH anticoagulation is now generally recommended.
claims.quote: it is generally now recommended to anticoagulate with prophylactic subcutaneous low molecular weight heparin.

claims.text: LMWH in renal insufficiency: reduce the dose and check anti-Xa levels (target 0.5–1.2 IU/mL, 3–4 h after the 4th dose);
claims.quote: In patients with renal insufficiency, dose reductions are needed, and subsequent verification of appropriate dosing should be done by checking serum factor Xa levels (target: 0.5 to 1.2 IU/mL measured at 3 to 4 hours after the fourth dose).

claims.text: generally contraindicated in severe renal insufficiency.
claims.quote: Low molecular weight heparins are generally contraindicated in patients with severe renal insufficiency
